_budgetComment: The 'free' value reported by llama-server --list-devices is static: it does not reflect what other processes are using. The budget is therefore total minus the driver reserve, assuming an idle GPU. Measured example: 16303 total - 308 reserved = 15995, identical to nvidia-smi 'free' at idle.
_cacheComment: KV cache types supported by llama.cpp with their bytes per element. q4_1 = 20 bytes per block of 32; q4_0 = 18. Dropping to q4_0 buys about 10% more context at a small quality cost.
_overheadComment: Calibrated against nvidia-smi measurements on a 16 GB GPU with the 27B model: predicts real usage to within 15 MiB.

harness._packagesComment: Pi INSTALLS every registered package at startup; if one fails to build, Pi will not open. That is why piPackages is empty: install your extensions yourself, on the harness you choose. piPackagesRetired de-registers packages an earlier launcher version may have injected.
